title: Link European tilemap indexes to their producers
platforms: European ROM, Windows CLI via Wine
changes: Project 12 original task IDs through their bounded initializers to three geometry tables. Verify that every slot and its corresponding type-4 transfer row select the same stream.
validation: Wine 8vqao49y authenticates five original code windows. Wine mkryi11b applies the one-based task IDs and verifies E301 ownership for the selected geometry pointers, rows, descriptors and streams. Both servers drained and protected inputs passed.
limitations: The four slots for IDs 9, 10, 130 and 133 have 140 unowned bytes. Ordinary triggers, external writes, managed reads, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open.
